motw: Asher scored 48, the best of the week. Gakpo (11), Gvardiol (8) and Donnarumma (7) did the heavy lifting. Now 1st on 169.
stinker: 22 points. That's the lot. A.Becker top-scored with 8, which tells you how the rest went. Down 2 to 6th.
bench: 14 points left on the bench. Sels (6), Aina (1), Awoniyi (2) and Šeško (5) watched from the side. Team selection remains an art, not a science.
bench_jam: Bruno G. didn't play, so Shaw came off Louie's bench and scored 4. 1 assist. Luck is a skill if you say it confidently.
red_card: Thiaw (Newcastle) returned -1 for Josh. Featuring an own goal.
gloves: Pickford (Everton) scored 1 for Jack. Conceded 2. Made 1 saves, for what it's worth.
